seo__search_description: Thank you for contacting Oakdene House Foundation. We will be in touch as soon as possible.
thank_you_confirmation__title: Thank you for getting in touch
thank_you_confirmation__text: We have received your message and will be in touch as soon as possible.
thank_you_confirmation__text_2: If your enquiry is urgent, please call us directly on [(02) 8717 0999](tel:0287170999). Our team is available Monday to Friday during business hours.
thank_you_confirmation__text_3: We will review your message within 2 business days
thank_you_confirmation__text_4: A member of our team will contact you to follow up
thank_you_confirmation__text_5: If you need immediate support, please visit our [Need Help Now](/need-help-now/) page
